# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `memory-fit` MCP server pointing at Memory.fit's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://api.memory.fit/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: `plugin.json` points at the submitted logo URL because the image could not be downloaded when this plugin was added.
